# Synthetic reference fixture

This is an isolated contract example, not a heritage chapter or a model/player evaluation. All source text, diagram, people and records are invented. The source text and SVG are original, test-only assets. There is no real historical claim, external image permission or human production approval in this fixture.

The behavior reference is demo-muradiye commit `656f2ba81875855e51e12fab3862629d120c6096`, `prototype/engine.mjs` and `data/muradiye-story.json`: observing a location, choosing help/hurry, then reading witness and time consequences. The mapping is in [reference-mapping.json](reference-mapping.json). No source code, database or original image was copied. New source IDs and local SHA-256 locators explicitly identify synthetic material.

[bundle.json](bundle.json) contains the route, three versioned packages, separate references and synthetic test review records. The smaller files provide standalone package samples and every first-profile module request/result. [manifest.json](manifest.json) declares which complete wire samples must pass or fail. Invalid samples are intentional test inputs, not broken generated schemas.

Inspect the synthetic hatch and obtain a fictional delivery record; choose whether to spend two story minutes assisting a witness; the next scene's feedback reads that choice. Both branches keep the delivery location known but differ on carrier identification. This demonstrates expressible data dependencies, not that the game is enjoyable or the inference is historically valid.

Five `vector-*.json` files freeze JS behavior. Their declarative template metadata `evaluation_status` remains `not_run`; F7 now executes all five against the shared JS interpreter and reports actual outcomes separately. The conflict runtime introduces inconsistent writes and must produce atomic EFFECT_CONFLICT. Merely validating the documents still does not execute them. See [F7 checks](../../../docs/IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md#10-game-runtime-actions-and-saves).

The fixture uses `environment=test`, `distribution_scope=internal_preview` and synthetic actors. Never import these approvals into an authoritative editorial DB or export them for public play. A real chapter must receive real source, asset/route, narrative and publication decisions.

## Resource reader registration

`resources.json` explicitly registers the synthetic source and SVG by project, identity, version, raw-byte hash and local path. It is the local reader configuration for F3, not a runtime package template or a grant of production rights. Test mode may rebind fixture-project registrations to a synthetic test project; production does not enable that mapping. Runtime media paths are generated from asset identity/hash and may differ from the historical runtime.json wire sample.
